content.title: RBC Heritage 2026: Winner’s Payout & Prize Money Earnings
content.text: Apr 19, 2026, 6:34 PM min read (AP Photo/Chris Carlson) The RBC Heritage was April 16-19. It was a PGA Tour signature event, so has a $20 million purse and $3.6 million winner's share. Matt Fitzpatrick won the event for a second time. In its annual spot the week after the Masters, the RBC Heritage was April 16-19 from Harbour Town Golf Links in Hilton Head, South Carolina. It was a PGA Tour signature event with a loaded field, including Scottie Scheffler, Xander Schauffele, Cameron Young, Chris Gotterup and more. As has happened virtually every year, the tournament was decided in a playoff, where Matt Fitzpatrick beat Scottie Scheffler with a birdie. Both players finished the event at 18-under. It was Fitzpatrick’s second win of the season and the second time he’s won this event. The event had a $20 million purse. How Much Does the Winner of the 2026 RBC Heritage Make? Matt Fitzpatrick’s winner’s share for the 2026 RBC Heritage was $3.6 million.
